description: Update a manually-managed crypto balance. Only the supplied fields change. The symbol of an existing balance cannot be changed.

balance.description: New balance as a numeric string with up to 18 decimal places. Pass a string to avoid losing precision.

crypto_id.description: Id of the manual crypto balance to update. Synced crypto balances cannot be updated.

display_name.description: New display name for the crypto asset. Pass null to clear it.

institution_name.description: New institution or wallet provider display name. Pass null to clear it.

name.description: New name for the crypto asset.

name: update_manual_crypto
